text:
Shane Wright is a Predator now. Seattle sent the fourth pick of the 2022 draft to Nashville for Matthew Wood on Nov. 1, ending a Kraken tenure that started with the most watched draft-night slide in recent memory, and Yahoo Sports had him fitting in fast beside Filip Forsberg in his first game. Nashville has won all four games since.

The production hasn't come with him. He's pointless in nine straight on 3.1 expected goals, and our form check says the chances have thinned too, so this isn't only bad luck. Four points in 18 games is well under the range we'd expect. What Nashville is buying is the rest of the game: Evolving-Hockey had him at 1.3 wins above replacement last season, 125th of 401 forwards, mostly on defence, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 65% of his exits leaving the zone with possession. He keeps chances against down. Watch whether the Predators give him real offensive minutes; at about 14.6 a night, the scoring will stay modest.
